how_to_apply: Visit the official OAVS website at www.oav.edu.in.
Open the recruitment section on the homepage.
Download and read the detailed Advertisement No. 01/2026.
Check the post-wise qualification, age limit and other eligibility conditions.
Complete the registration using the required personal details.
Fill in the educational, professional and employment information.
Upload the required photograph, signature and certificates.
Pay the application fee if prescribed in the detailed notification.
Review and submit the application before 11 November 2026 at 5:00 PM.
Download or print the submitted application for future reference.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted through the official online application link. No other method of application submission will be accepted. Candidates must verify their eligibility before submitting the application. Applicants should enter only correct and valid information in the application form. Candidates should regularly visit the OAVS website for the detailed notification, instructions and recruitment updates. The application must be completed before the closing time on the last date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under OAVS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 815 vacancies have been announced.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are included in the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Principal and Teacher posts in different disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the OAVS advertisement number?
Q4. When will the online application process begin?
faq.answer: Online registration will begin on 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for completing online registration is 11 November 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be appointed in Odisha Adarsha Vidyalayas and Odisha Mining Adarsha Vidyalayas in Odisha.
